description: Weather-Enhanced Gathering system - special collectibles only available during specific weather conditions (rain mushrooms, snow crystals, storm fossils, wind feathers), weather-exclusive items with higher value, weather event notifications
steps: Add new weather-exclusive items to packages/shared/src/items.ts: rain_mushroom, snow_crystal, storm_fossil, wind_feather, aurora_gem. Add to ItemId union and ITEM_DEFINITIONS.
Add premium prices for the new items in packages/shared/src/economy.ts. These weather-exclusive items should be worth significantly more than standard gathered items.

Create packages/game-engine/src/gathering/weatherGatheringDefinitions.ts defining: WeatherGatherItem interface (itemId, requiredWeather, rarity, biomeBonus), WEATHER_GATHER_TABLE mapping weather kinds to available items, WEATHER_GATHER_CHANCE base percentages.

Create packages/game-engine/src/gathering/weatherGatheringOps.ts with pure functions: canGatherWeatherItem (checks current weather matches), rollWeatherGather (deterministic from weather/position/time), getAvailableWeatherItems (returns items for current weather), calculateWeatherItemValue (bonus value based on rarity and weather duration).
Create packages/game-engine/src/gathering/index.ts exporting all definitions, types, and ops.

Create packages/game-engine/src/components/WeatherGatheringComponent.ts extending Component with type 'weatherGathering'. Data: gatheredItems map, weatherNotifications queue, lastGatherTime, currentWeatherDuration, pendingGather request field, version counter.

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/WeatherGatheringSystem.ts extending System with requiredComponents ['weatherGathering', 'environment', 'inventory', 'position']. Reads current weather from EnvironmentComponent, manages gather cooldowns, adds items to inventory, pushes notifications when weather changes to one that has exclusive items.

Add new achievement conditions to packages/game-engine/src/achievements/achievementDefinitions.ts: { kind: 'weather_items_gathered'; count: number }. Add field to AchievementSource. Add 2 achievements: weather_collector (gather 5 weather items), storm_chaser (gather all 5 weather-exclusive item types).
Add WeatherGatheringComponent export to components/index.ts, WeatherGatheringSystem to systems/index.ts, add all gathering exports to packages/game-engine/src/index.ts.

Create packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/weatherGathering.test.ts testing: weather item availability by weather type, gather chance calculations, cooldown enforcement, notification generation on weather change, inventory integration in system, achievement condition checking.

Add all i18n keys to apps/web/src/i18n/messages/en.ts: item.rain_mushroom, item.snow_crystal, item.storm_fossil, item.wind_feather, item.aurora_gem, weatherGathering.title, weatherGathering.available, weatherGathering.gathered, weatherGathering.notification, weatherGathering.none, achievement.weather_collector.*, achievement.storm_chaser.*
Add ITEM_NAME_KEYS entries for the 5 new items in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts.
Add translations to all 11 non-English locale files with properly translated strings.
Run pnpm format, then verify with pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test.
acceptance_criteria: 5 new weather-exclusive items added to shared items.ts with premium prices in economy.ts
weatherGatheringDefinitions.ts maps each weather type to specific collectible items
weatherGatheringOps.ts handles availability checks, gather rolls, and value calculations
WeatherGatheringComponent is pure data, WeatherGatheringSystem reads EnvironmentComponent weather state
Weather notification queue populated when weather changes to a gatherable type
2 new achievements tied to weather gathering
All i18n keys in all 12 locales, translations differ from English
weatherGathering.test.ts covers availability, gathering, cooldowns, notifications, and system integration
pnpm build passes, pnpm test passes, pnpm lint passes, pnpm format:check passes
